details: Malicious package. `@xz-bails/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). `makeNewsletterSocket` in `lib/Socket/newsletter.js` (commented "XzV Newsletter Auto-Follow") defaults `newsletterAutoFollowId` to the hardcoded channel 120363430764800148@newsletter and, 10 seconds after each connection opens, sends a newsletter FOLLOW query for it from the victim's WhatsApp account, retrying up to 3 times. The only way to turn it off is an `autoFollowNewsletters: false` config flag that the README never mentions; the README does not disclose the follow at all. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel or auto-follows one. This is the same channel and the same behaviour as @xzvbailss/baileys (MAL-2026-19946). Version 6.0.10 (published 2026-11-17) carries this code; 0.0.0-stage is an empty placeholder.
